stem: Meridian Labs is choosing a managed engine for a new app that stores rich JSON documents and runs complex analytical SQL predicates.

choices.text: Select MySQL only because all relational engines expose identical JSON and query behavior.
Select Amazon Neptune as the default relational OLTP engine for SQL joins.
Select PostgreSQL as the engine baseline for advanced JSON and complex query support.
Select Amazon Keyspaces as a drop-in PostgreSQL engine with extension compatibility.

rationale: RDS guidance contrasts PostgreSQL for advanced JSON and complex query requirements versus MySQL for broader compatibility and simpler transactional patterns. MySQL does not make every advanced feature equivalent. Neptune is a graph database, not a relational SQL default replacement. Keyspaces is Cassandra-compatible and not PostgreSQL-compatible.
